name: Juicebox
tagline: PeopleGPT — natural-language candidate sourcing across 800M+ profiles.
description: Juicebox is an AI recruiting platform whose core product, PeopleGPT, lets recruiters search 800M+ profiles across 30+ sources using natural-language prompts instead of boolean filters. It verifies candidates and automates multi-step personalized outreach, and integrates with dozens of ATS and CRM systems plus a Chrome extension.
insight: A Y Combinator (S22) company; raised a $30M Series A led by Sequoia in 2025 (part of $36M total).
edge: Pioneered natural-language ('PeopleGPT') sourcing — describe the candidate in a sentence rather than building boolean strings.

references.title: Juicebox lands $30M to transform recruiting with PeopleGPT
